entities.summary: Eucharius Rösslin , sometimes known as Eucharius Rhodion, was a German physician who in 1513 wrote a book about childbirth called Der Rosengarten, which became a standard medical text for midwives. Its full title was Der schwangern Frauwen und Hebammen Rosengarten.

entities.summary: Eucharius Rösslin , sometimes known as Eucharius Rhodion, was a German physician who in 1513 wrote a book about childbirth called Der Rosengarten, which became a standard medical text for midwives. Its full title was Der schwangern Frauwen und Hebammen Rosengarten.
